Variants.Content: First frost is the first sign of the season when temperatures allow dew to freeze on grass blades, roof tiles and roads. Farmers rush to harvest crops, check roofs and store grain, while travelers beware of early morning thin ice; in the north, the first frost reminds everyone that the promise of summer is about to lose its weight.
